title: Synthetic-to-Real Pose Estimation with Geometric Reconstruction

layout.note: Two stacked panels with centred titles underneath: (a) a left-to-right module chain on a white ground with a dashed symbol key in the top-right corner, (b) a light-grey dashed frame holding a left-to-right formula chain with thumbnails at both ends.

lesson: In a vision method, put a thumbnail of the real intermediate map where each module outputs it, and define the many symbols once in a dashed key in the empty corner; use a second panel to open only the module that is new.
